description: This is a CMake configuration file for setting up the build environment for iOS development on Darwin (macOS). It defines platform-specific options, compiler settings, SDK locations, and macros to facilitate cross-compilation for different iOS targets such as device and simulator platforms.

methods.name: set_xcode_property
methods.description: A macro to set Xcode specific properties on targets.

methods.name: find_host_package
methods.description: A macro to find host system executables, not within the iOS environment.
